[IRET.22.3] **NOT nodes.** Token blocked on
right-activation (new blocking fact); token propagated on
right-retraction (block count drops to zero); token
retracted on right-activation when it was previously
propagated; multiple blocking facts (`block_count > 1`).

idris.name: ldet_5_9__refresh_with
idris.note: The four transitions as a recomputed Bool: blocked when a live fact of the `no` kind matches, propagated when none does. `block_count` is not kept (the count > 1 case collapses into "some blocker"), and a blocked token is flagged rather than retracted, which is what lets it keep its position per [LDET.5.9].
